head_literal_lets.name: population
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let population : Ω → Shao.Path n := Shao.Probability.samplePath X

head_literal_lets.name: rawEnergy
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let rawEnergy : Ω → ℝ := fun omega => ∑ i : Fin n, (X i omega) ^ 2

head_literal_lets.name: rawTerminal
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let rawTerminal : Ω → ℝ := fun omega => ∑ i : Fin n, X i omega

head_literal_lets.name: W
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let W : Ω → ℝ := fun omega => Shao.C1.normalizedEndpoint (population omega)

head_literal_lets.name: sigmaSq
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let sigmaSq : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, z ^ 2 ∂rho

head_literal_lets.name: scale
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let scale : ℝ := Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) * sigmaSq)

head_literal_lets.name: normalizedLaw
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let normalizedLaw : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => z / scale) rho

head_literal_lets.name: R
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let R : ℝ := Shao.truncationBudget normalizedLaw n 0

head_literal_lets.name: P
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let P : Measure (Shao.Path n) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => rho)

head_literal_lets.name: labelLaw
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let labelLaw : Measure (LabelPerm n) := uniformPermutationLaw n

head_literal_lets.name: jointLaw
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let jointLaw : Measure (Ω × LabelPerm n) := mu.prod labelLaw

head_literal_lets.name: pairedPopulation
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text:
let pairedPopulation : Ω × LabelPerm n → Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n :=
            fun p => (population p.1, p.2)

head_literal_lets.name: shuffled
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text:
let shuffled : Ω × LabelPerm n → Shao.Path n :=
            fun p => Shao.Probability.Spitzer.reorder (population p.1) p.2

head_literal_lets.name: Q
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let Q : Measure BridgeNoise := bridgeLaw B PB

head_literal_lets.name: signedMax
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let signedMax : Ω → ℝ := fun omega => Shao.upperMax (s • population omega) hn

head_literal_lets.name: J
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let J : MonitoredDomain := if s = 1 then .upper else .lower

head_literal_lets.name: V0
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text:
let V0 : LabelPerm n → Ω → ℝ := fun sigma omega =>
              sourceValue J (eventCompletionKernel J Q) (population omega) x 0 sigma

head_literal_lets.name: A
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text: let A : Set Ω := {omega | signedMax omega < x * Real.sqrt (rawEnergy omega)}

head_literal_lets.name: AB
head_literal_lets.complete_source_text:
let AB : Set ΩB := {omegaB | ∀ t : BridgeTime,
              s * B ⟨(t : ℝ), t.property.1⟩ omegaB < x}
